title: Connectivity of a multigraph
statement: A regular multigraph $G$ is connected if, for every pair of vertices $u,v$, there is a finite sequence of adjacency steps from $u$ to $v$, allowing a sequence of zero steps when $u=v$.
hypotheses_covered: A vertex type with decidable equality
